summary.text: Courtney Watson is a Democratic member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 9B who has served since January 2019 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An insurance executive, she previously served on the Howard County Council and the Howard County Board of Education and sits on the House Appropriations Committee.

paragraphs.text: Watson was born in Baltimore, attended Atholton High School, and earned a bachelor's degree and an MBA from Loyola University.

She was an assistant vice president at Charter Corporation from 1984 to 1991, a vice president at Rossmann Hurt Hoffman from 1992 to 2017, and has been an insurance executive at HUB International Mid-Atlantic since 2017.
Watson was a member and chair of the Board of Education of Howard County from 2002 to 2006 and a member and chair of the Howard County Council from 2006 to 2014.
She served on the Howard Community College Board of Trustees from 2015 to 2018 and was president of the Electoral College of Maryland in 2016.
She was first elected to the House in 2018 and took office on January 9, 2019.

She served on the Economic Matters Committee from 2019 to 2022 and has been a member of the Appropriations Committee since 2023, where she chairs the Transportation and Environment Subcommittee; she was a Deputy Majority Whip from 2023 to 2026.
